title: Translate an Ionic CLI ionic:build/ionic:serve hook call into the matching Nx target

hook.description: Which Ionic CLI hook invoked this executor.

platform.description: The target platform (e.g. 'android', 'ios') forwarded by the Ionic CLI.

host.description: The dev-server host, used by the serve hook only.

port.description: The dev-server port, used by the serve hook only.

buildConfiguration.description: The configuration the Ionic CLI requested; the mapped target runs under it.
